title: Private Idol Disc: Tokubetsu-hen: Can Gal '97
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ 【特別編】 キャンペーン・ガール’９７
overview: Private Idol Disc Tokubetsuhen: Can Gal '97 is a multimedia photobook of so-called "campaign girls", who are models who appear in advertising and corporate promotion. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of 18 girls, as well as a quiz minigame with 10 questions. There is no bonus reward for completing the minigame.
